summary.zh: 三角洲之战是古埃及与海上民族之间的一场海战，发生于约公元前1175年，法老拉美西斯三世击退了这次大规模海上入侵。交战地点在尼罗河三角洲东岸与埃及在叙利亚的边界一带，确切位置不明。这场战事记录于拉美西斯三世位于梅迪内特哈布的葬祭庙墙壁上。
summary.en: The battle of the Delta was a sea battle between Egypt and the Sea Peoples, circa 1175 BC, in which pharaoh Ramesses III repelled a seaborne invasion. The fighting took place on the eastern Nile Delta and near Egypt's Syrian border, though the precise locations are unknown. It is recorded on the walls of his mortuary temple at Medinet Habu.

significance.zh: 此役遏止了海上民族对埃及的入侵，是青铜时代晚期动荡中埃及得以延续的关键一战。
significance.en: It stopped the Sea Peoples' invasion and is seen as a key reason Egypt survived the Late Bronze Age collapse.

summary.zh: 卡尔卡尔之战是公元前853年新亚述帝国与西亚诸国联军在卡尔卡尔的一场会战。亚述国王沙尔马那塞尔三世对阵由哈达德泽尔与以色列王亚哈等率领的十一国联军。此役参战人数超过以往任何战役，阿拉伯人等族群首次见于文献记载，战况刻于库尔赫石碑。
summary.en: The battle of Qarqar was fought in 853 BC between the Neo-Assyrian army of Shalmaneser III and an allied force of eleven kings led by Hadadezer of Aram-Damascus and Ahab of Israel. It is notable for the number of combatants and for the first recorded appearance of peoples such as the Arabs, and is recorded on the Kurkh Monoliths.

significance.zh: 它是古代西亚规模空前的会战，其铭文是亚述史料中最早记录阿拉伯人等族群的一次。
significance.en: It was the largest battle of its region up to that time and its inscription is the earliest Assyrian record naming peoples such as the Arabs.

summary.zh: 勒吉鲁斯湖战役是罗马共和国初年罗马对阵拉丁同盟的一场交战，传统上系于公元前496年前后，带有浓厚传说色彩。流亡的末代国王塔克文·苏佩布与其婿、图斯库卢姆独裁官奥克塔维乌斯·马米利乌斯率拉丁军试图复辟，被罗马独裁官波斯图米乌斯击退。传说卡斯托尔与波吕克斯曾助战罗马一方。
summary.en: The battle of Lake Regillus was a legendary Roman victory over the Latin League shortly after the republic was founded. The Latins, led by the exiled king Lucius Tarquinius Superbus and his son-in-law Octavius Mamilius, marched to restore the Tarquins; the Romans under the dictator Aulus Postumius defeated them. Legend has Castor and Pollux fighting on the Roman side.

significance.zh: 它被视为塔克文家族复辟企图的终结，也是罗马共和国早期对拉丁同盟确立优势的标志性战役。
significance.en: It ended the Tarquins' attempt to reclaim the throne and became the founding military legend of the early Roman Republic.

summary.zh: 安菲波利斯战役发生于公元前422年，是伯罗奔尼撒战争期间雅典与斯巴达之间的一场交战。此役是前424年斯巴达夺取安菲波利斯后一系列事件的高潮；雅典将领克里昂与斯巴达将领伯拉西达在城下交锋，两人均阵亡。次年双方签订尼基阿斯和约。
summary.en: The battle of Amphipolis was fought in 422 BC during the Peloponnesian War between Athens and Sparta, the culmination of events that began with the Spartan capture of Amphipolis in 424 BC. Both the Athenian commander Cleon and the Spartan Brasidas were killed, and the following year the two sides concluded the Peace of Nicias.

significance.zh: 两位主将阵亡促成了次年尼基阿斯和约的签订，为十年战争暂划句点。
significance.en: The deaths of both commanders cleared the way for the Peace of Nicias the following year.

summary.zh: 兹库斯之战发生于公元前410年5、6月间，是伯罗奔尼撒战争期间雅典与斯巴达在马尔马拉海沿岸兹库斯附近的一场海战。雅典舰队由阿尔西比亚德斯、色拉西布洛斯和塞拉门尼斯指挥，击溃并摧毁了明达鲁斯统率的斯巴达舰队。此后一年雅典重新控制了赫勒斯滂沿岸多座城市。
summary.en: The battle of Cyzicus took place in May or June 410 BC during the Peloponnesian War. An Athenian fleet commanded by Alcibiades, Thrasybulus and Theramenes routed and destroyed the Spartan fleet under Mindarus. Over the following year Athens recovered control of several cities along the Hellespont, and a Spartan peace offer was rejected.

significance.zh: 此役摧毁斯巴达舰队，使雅典重夺赫勒斯滂的控制权，扭转了战争后期的颓势。
significance.en: The destruction of the Spartan fleet restored Athenian control of the Hellespont and reversed Athens' fortunes late in the war.

summary.zh: 诺提姆之战发生于公元前406年，是伯罗奔尼撒战争期间斯巴达在海上取得的一次胜利。雅典将领阿尔西比亚德斯此前将舰队交给舵手安条克指挥，安条克违令以诱敌小船挑动斯巴达舰队出战，结果被吕山德击败。此役导致阿尔西比亚德斯失势，也确立了吕山德在海上对抗雅典的声威。
summary.en: The battle of Notium, also called the battle of Ephesus, was a Spartan naval victory in 406 BC during the Peloponnesian War. Alcibiades had left his helmsman Antiochus in command of the Athenian fleet blockading Ephesus; against orders Antiochus tried to lure the Spartans out with a decoy and was defeated by Lysander. The defeat ended Alcibiades' command.

significance.zh: 此役使阿尔西比亚德斯失去指挥权，并确立了吕山德作为能击败雅典舰队的将领的声威。
significance.en: It ended Alcibiades' command and established Lysander as a commander able to beat the Athenians at sea.

summary.zh: 梅德韦战役发生于公元43年，地点可能在今英格兰肯特郡的梅德韦河一带，当时属于铁器时代的坎提亚基部落领地。此役是克劳狄乌斯入侵不列颠行动早期的一场交战，罗马军队由将领奥卢斯·普劳提乌斯统率。这场战役的确切位置至今仍未有定论。
summary.en: The battle of the Medway took place in 43 AD, probably on the River Medway in the lands of the Iron Age Cantiaci tribe, in what is now the English county of Kent. It was an early battle in the Claudian invasion of Britain, led by Aulus Plautius.

significance.zh: 它是罗马征服不列颠过程中的早期关键交战，为罗马在东南不列颠的推进打开通道。
significance.en: It was an early Roman victory that opened the way for the conquest of south-eastern Britain.

summary.zh: 卢格杜努姆战役发生于197年2月19日，地点在今法国里昂，是罗马皇帝塞普蒂米乌斯·塞维鲁与篡位者克洛狄乌斯·阿尔比努斯之间的决战。塞维鲁获胜，成为罗马帝国唯一的皇帝，结束了五帝之年的余波。此役被认为是罗马军队之间规模最大、最惨烈的交战之一。
summary.en: The battle of Lugdunum was fought on 19 February 197 at Lugdunum, modern Lyon, between the armies of the emperor Septimius Severus and the usurper Clodius Albinus. Severus' victory made him sole emperor after the Year of the Five Emperors. It is described as one of the largest and bloodiest clashes between Roman forces.

significance.zh: 塞维鲁的胜利终结了帝位争夺，开启了塞维鲁王朝对帝国的统治。
significance.en: Severus' victory ended the contest for the throne and inaugurated the Severan dynasty's rule over the empire.

summary.zh: 泰西封战役发生于363年5月29日，是罗马皇帝尤利安远征萨珊波斯期间在波斯首都泰西封城外进行的一场交战。罗马军队与沙普尔二世治下的萨珊波斯军队对阵，罗马一方在城下获胜，但因远离己方补给线而无法继续推进，这次远征随后以失败告终。
summary.en: The battle of Ctesiphon took place on 29 May 363 between the army of the Roman emperor Julian and the Sasanian forces of Shapur II outside the walls of the Persian capital. The Romans won, but found themselves too far from their supply lines to continue the campaign, which ended in failure.

significance.zh: 罗马虽在城下获胜却无力续攻，此役暴露出远征军深入波斯的补给困境。
significance.en: The victory outside the capital could not be exploited, exposing how far the Roman expedition had outrun its supply lines.

summary.zh: 巴当山之战（又称巴多尼库斯山之战）是后罗马时期不列颠人与盎格鲁-撒克逊人的交战，传统上系于500年前后。据吉尔达斯约543至547年的记述，不列颠人取得重大胜利，暂时阻止了盎格鲁-撒克逊诸王国西进。9世纪《不列颠史》将指挥官亚瑟列入参战者，此战因而与亚瑟王传说相连。
summary.en: The battle of Badon, also called Mons Badonicus, was purportedly fought between Britons and Anglo-Saxons in post-Roman Britain in the early sixth century. Gildas, writing around 543-547, credits the Britons with a major victory that halted the westward advance of the Anglo-Saxon kingdoms. The ninth-century Historia Brittonum names a commander called Arthur among the participants.

significance.zh: 它被视为不列颠人阻止盎格鲁-撒克逊西进的关键胜利，也是亚瑟王传说最早的史事依托之一。
significance.en: It is remembered as the Britons' decisive check on Anglo-Saxon expansion and as one of the earliest historical anchors of the Arthurian legend.

summary.zh: 韦兹龙斯之战发生于524年6月21日，地点在今法国伊泽尔省，是法兰克国王克洛多梅尔与勃艮第国王戈多马尔之间的交战。此役是克洛维一世诸子瓜分勃艮第远征的一部分；据图尔的格列高利记载，克洛多梅尔误入敌阵被杀，戈多马尔虽胜，其王国仍在十年内被墨洛温王朝吞并。
summary.en: The battle of Vezronce was fought on 21 June 524 near Vezronce-Curtin in Isere, France, between the Franks under King Chlodomer and the Burgundians under King Godomar. It was part of Clovis I's sons' campaign against Burgundy; Chlodomer was killed riding into the enemy line, and Godomar's kingdom was absorbed within a decade.

significance.zh: 此役虽由勃艮第方面获胜，但勃艮第王国仍在十年内被墨洛温王朝吞并。
significance.en: Godomar won the battle, but the Burgundian kingdom was absorbed by the Merovingians within a decade.

summary.zh: 卡利奈孔战役发生于531年4月19日，是伊比利亚战争期间拜占庭帝国与萨珊波斯在卡利奈孔（今叙利亚拉卡附近）的交战。波斯将领阿扎雷特斯入侵叙利亚，拜占庭将领贝利撒留率军追击。拜占庭军队苦战后战败，波斯一方亦损失惨重，双方于次年议和。
summary.en: The battle of Callinicum took place on 19 April 531, the Saturday before Easter, between the Byzantine and Sasanian empires during the Iberian War. The Persian commander Azarethes invaded Syria and Belisarius pursued him to Callinicum, where the Byzantines were defeated after hard fighting; the war ended with peace the following year.

significance.zh: 此役结束了伊比利亚战争阶段的战事，双方损耗巨大，为532年的和约铺路。
significance.en: It closed the fighting of the Iberian War and, with both armies exhausted, paved the way for the peace of 532.

summary.zh: 维苏威战役（蒙斯·拉克塔里乌斯之战）发生于552年10月，是哥特战争末期拜占庭与东哥特王国在维苏威火山附近的一次决战。东哥特国王托提拉在塔吉纳战死后，泰亚继位并率残部解库迈之围，被拜占庭将领纳尔西斯拦截。双方对峙两月后决战，泰亚阵亡，东哥特王国有组织的抵抗随之瓦解。
summary.en: The battle of Mons Lactarius took place in October 552 during the Gothic War between Byzantine forces under Narses and the Ostrogoths near Mount Vesuvius. After King Totila's death at Taginae, his successor Teia marched to relieve Cumae and was intercepted; after two months of stalemate Teia was killed, ending organised Gothic royal leadership.

significance.zh: 此役终结了东哥特王国的有组织抵抗，为拜占庭重新控制意大利铺平道路。
significance.en: It ended organised Ostrogothic resistance and cleared the way for the Byzantine reconquest of Italy.

summary.zh: 塔吉纳战役（又称布斯塔·加洛鲁姆之战）发生于552年7月，是哥特战争后期拜占庭将领纳尔西斯与东哥特国王托提拉之间的决战。纳尔西斯自达尔马提亚沿亚得里亚海岸进入意大利，与托提拉在塔吉纳交锋。托提拉战死，东哥特王国就此瓦解，拜占庭得以重新征服意大利半岛。
summary.en: The battle of Taginae, also called Busta Gallorum, was fought in July 552 between the Byzantines under Narses and the Ostrogoths under King Totila in the late stage of the Gothic War. Narses marched from Dalmatia into Italy; Totila was killed and the Gothic kingdom dissolved, opening the way for the Byzantine reconquest of the peninsula.

significance.zh: 托提拉之死与东哥特主力的覆灭，使拜占庭得以在意大利重建统治。
significance.en: The death of Totila and the destruction of the Gothic field army allowed Byzantium to re-establish its rule in Italy.

summary.zh: 大马士革围城战自634年8月21日持续至9月19日，以城市向拉希敦哈里发国投降告终。大马士革是穆斯林征服叙利亚过程中陷落的第一座东罗马帝国重镇。此前哈里发阿布·伯克尔于634年4月入侵黎凡特，并在阿杰纳代因战役中击败拜占庭军队。
summary.en: The siege of Damascus lasted from 21 August to 19 September 634 and ended with the city's surrender to the Rashidun Caliphate. Damascus was the first major Eastern Roman city to fall in the Muslim conquest of Syria, after Caliph Abu Bakr invaded the Levant in April 634 and defeated a Byzantine army at Ajnadayn.

significance.zh: 作为穆斯林征服叙利亚攻下的第一座大城，它为此后黎凡特战事打开了门户。
significance.en: As the first major city taken in the Muslim conquest of Syria, it opened the Levant to the advancing caliphate.

summary.zh: 法尔战役（又称贝桑战役）发生于634年12月或635年1月，是穆斯林征服拜占庭叙利亚期间的一场重要交战，地点在约旦河谷的佩拉（法尔）与斯基托波利斯（贝桑）附近。此前在阿杰纳代因溃败的拜占庭军队在此重新集结，阿拉伯军队追击而至，克服了被放水淹没的地面并最终取胜。
summary.en: The battle of Fahl, also called the Battle of Beisan, was a major engagement of the Muslim conquest of Byzantine Syria, fought at or near Pella and Scythopolis in the Jordan Valley in December 634 or January 635. Byzantine troops regrouped there after their rout at Ajnadayn; the Muslims pursued them, overcame flooded ground and won.

significance.zh: 它是穆斯林征服拜占庭叙利亚的关键一战，为控制约旦河谷与巴勒斯坦打开通道。
significance.en: It was a key engagement in the conquest of Byzantine Syria and opened the Jordan Valley to the Muslim advance.

summary.zh: 赫利奥波利斯战役（又称艾因沙姆斯战役）发生于公元640年，是阿拉伯穆斯林军队与拜占庭帝国军队争夺埃及控制权的一场决定性会战。此役之后虽然仍有多次交锋，但拜占庭在埃及的统治实际上已告终结，并为穆斯林征服罗马非洲总督区打开门户。
summary.en: The battle of Heliopolis, also called Ayn Shams, was fought in 640 between Arab Muslim armies and Byzantine forces for control of Egypt. Although skirmishes continued afterwards, the battle effectively decided the fate of Byzantine rule in Egypt and opened the way for the Muslim conquest of the Roman Exarchate of Africa.

significance.zh: 它决定了拜占庭在埃及统治的结局，为穆斯林势力向西推进打开门户。
significance.en: It sealed the fate of Byzantine Egypt and opened the door to Muslim expansion further west.

summary.zh: 图卢兹战役是公元721年阿基坦公爵奥多率军击败围攻图卢兹的倭马亚军队的一战。安达卢斯总督萨姆赫·本·马利克·豪拉尼率倭马亚军队围城，奥多率阿基坦军队解围并将其击溃，萨姆赫阵亡。此役遏止了倭马亚势力自纳博讷向西进入阿基坦的扩张。
summary.en: The battle of Toulouse (721) was a victory of an Aquitanian Christian army under Duke Odo the Great over the Umayyad force besieging Toulouse, commanded by al-Samh ibn Malik al-Khawlani, governor of al-Andalus. Odo relieved the city and routed the besiegers; al-Samh was killed. The victory checked the westward spread of Umayyad control from Narbonne into Aquitaine.

significance.zh: 它是法兰克地区抵挡倭马亚扩张的关键胜利，使阿基坦在此后一段时间免于被纳入安达卢斯。
significance.en: It was a decisive check on Umayyad expansion beyond Narbonne and kept Aquitaine out of al-Andalus for the following years.

summary.zh: 克朗塔夫战役发生于1014年4月23日，地点在都柏林附近的克朗塔夫，是爱尔兰高王布赖恩·博鲁与都柏林国王西特里格、伦斯特国王梅尔·莫尔达及外来维京军队的决战。战斗自日出持续至日落，维京与伦斯特联军溃败，阵亡者估计7000至10000人。布赖恩本人及其子、孙均在战后被杀。
summary.en: The battle of Clontarf was fought on 23 April 1014 at Clontarf near Dublin. Brian Boru, High King of Ireland, faced a Norse-Irish alliance of Sigtrygg Silkbeard of Dublin, Mael Morda of Leinster and Viking forces from abroad. The fighting lasted from sunrise to sunset and ended in a rout; between 7,000 and 10,000 men were killed, including Brian himself.

significance.zh: 此役遏止了维京势力在爱尔兰的扩张，但布赖恩之死使其家族未能建立统一的王权。
significance.en: It broke Viking power in Ireland, though Brian's death prevented his family from consolidating a unified Irish kingship.

summary.zh: 1148年围攻大马士革发生于7月24日至28日，是第二次十字军东征期间的一次攻城战。法兰西国王路易七世、罗马人的国王康拉德三世与耶路撒冷王国的军队联合围攻塞尔柱势力控制的大马士革，最终被击退。此役失败使十字军国家与当地穆斯林盟友的关系破裂。
summary.en: The siege of Damascus took place between 24 and 28 July 1148 during the Second Crusade. Armies led by Louis VII of France and Conrad III of Germany joined the Kingdom of Jerusalem in attacking the Seljuk-held city, and the effort ended in a Crusader defeat. The failure broke Jerusalem's alliance with Damascus and helped seal the crusade's collapse.

significance.zh: 它是第二次十字军东征由盛转衰的转折点，也破坏了耶路撒冷王国在大马士革方向的盟友关系。
significance.en: It marked the failure of the Second Crusade and destroyed the Kingdom of Jerusalem's alliance with Damascus.

summary.zh: 迈尔季欧云之战发生于1179年6月，地点在利塔尼河附近的迈尔季欧云（今黎巴嫩境内），是耶路撒冷王国与萨拉丁统率的阿尤布军队之间的交战。萨拉丁取得决定性胜利，被视为其对抗十字军的一系列胜利的开端。患麻风病的国王鲍德温四世由卫队救出，侥幸未被俘。
summary.en: The battle of Marj Ayyun was fought in June 1179 near the Litani River in modern Lebanon between the Kingdom of Jerusalem under Baldwin IV and the Ayyubid army of Saladin. It ended in a decisive Muslim victory, the first of Saladin's long run of successes against the Crusader states, though the leper king Baldwin narrowly escaped capture.

significance.zh: 它是萨拉丁对十字军国家一连串胜利的开端，改变了耶路撒冷王国北部边境的态势。
significance.en: It opened Saladin's series of victories over the Crusader states and shifted the balance on Jerusalem's northern frontier.

summary.en: The battle of Cresson was a small engagement between Frankish and Egyptian Ayyubid forces on 1 May 1187 at the Spring of the Cresson, whose exact location near Nazareth is unknown. It served as the prelude to the Kingdom of Jerusalem's decisive defeat at the Horns of Hattin two months later.

significance.zh: 它被视为哈丁战役的前奏，暴露出耶路撒冷王国在野战中兵源与指挥的脆弱。
significance.en: It exposed the kingdom's weakness in the field and set up the disaster at Hattin.

summary.en: The battle of Fariskur was the last major engagement of the Seventh Crusade, fought on 6 April 1250 between the Crusaders under King Louis IX of France and Egyptian forces under Turanshah of the Ayyubid dynasty. After their defeat at Al Mansurah in February, the Crusader army was destroyed and Louis IX himself was captured.

significance.zh: 十字军主力在此覆灭、国王被俘，标志着第七次十字军东征的彻底失败。
significance.en: The destruction of the crusader army and the capture of the king ended the Seventh Crusade in complete failure.

summary.en: Portuguese forces under King John I captured the North African city of Ceuta from the Marinid Sultanate on 21 August 1415. After a carefully prepared assault the defences fell, and the capture is regarded as the beginning of the Portuguese Empire. Ceuta remained Portuguese until it passed to Spain in 1668.

significance.zh: 它被视为葡萄牙海外扩张与葡萄牙帝国的起点，开启了欧洲势力在非洲沿岸经营据点的阶段。
significance.en: It is regarded as the starting point of Portuguese overseas expansion and of the Portuguese Empire.

summary.zh: 切里尼奥拉战役发生于1503年4月28日，是西班牙与法国军队在意大利南部普利亚地区切里尼奥拉城外的一场交战。西班牙将领科尔多瓦率约9000人，以火绳枪兵与炮兵击退法军骑兵与瑞士长枪兵，法军主帅内穆尔公爵阵亡。此役常被认为是欧洲第一场由小型火器决定胜负的会战。
summary.en: The battle of Cerignola was fought on 28 April 1503 between Spanish and French armies outside Cerignola in Apulia. Gonzalo Fernandez de Cordoba's Spanish force of 9,000, with arquebusiers and artillery, broke the attacks of French gendarmes and Swiss pikemen; the French commander, the Duke of Nemours, was killed. It is often called the first European battle decided by firearms.

significance.zh: 此役被认为开启了火器主导欧洲战场的时代，也巩固了西班牙在意大利南部的优势。
significance.en: It is seen as the beginning of firearms' dominance on European battlefields and confirmed Spanish power in southern Italy.

summary.zh: 塔里克提之战（又称拉克沙西-坦加迪之战）发生于1565年1月23日，是维贾亚纳加尔帝国与德干诸苏丹国联军之间的一场决定性会战。维贾亚纳加尔一方由阿里亚·罗摩·拉亚统率，战败后帝国逐渐瓦解，德干政治格局随之重组。此役细节因原始史料叙述互相矛盾而难以重建。
summary.en: The battle of Talikota, also called Rakshasi-Tangadi, was a watershed battle fought on 23 January 1565 between the Vijayanagara Empire and an alliance of the Deccan sultanates. The defeat of Aliya Rama Raya led to the empire's eventual collapse and reconfigured Deccan politics. The details are notoriously hard to reconstruct because the primary sources contradict one another.

significance.zh: 此役导致维贾亚纳加尔帝国瓦解，重塑了德干地区此后的政治格局。
significance.en: It destroyed the Vijayanagara Empire and reshaped the political order of the Deccan.

summary.en: The battle of Imafuku was fought on 26 November 1614 between the forces of Tokugawa Ieyasu and the Toyotomi clan, one of the opening engagements of the winter campaign around Osaka. Ieyasu sent some 1,500 men under Satake Yoshinobu to seize the village; Toyotomi reinforcements counter-attacked, and only Uesugi Kagekatsu's arrival forced them back to Osaka castle.

significance.zh: 它是大坂冬之阵的开局之战之一，确立了德川方在大坂外围的据点，为次年攻灭丰臣氏铺路。
significance.en: As one of the first battles of the winter campaign, it secured a Tokugawa foothold around Osaka and prepared the clan's destruction the following year.

summary.en: The battle of Sediman was fought on 7 October 1798 during Napoleon's Egyptian campaign. After the Egyptian defeat at the Pyramids the Mamluk force retreated south, and General Louis Desaix pursued it; the two sides met near Sediman. Murad Bey's attempts at new tactics failed and he was forced to continue his retreat southwards.

significance.zh: 此役后穆拉德贝伊继续南撤，法军得以深入上埃及追击。
significance.en: After the battle Murad Bey continued his retreat south and the French were able to pursue him deeper into Upper Egypt.

summary.en: The battle of Mount Tabor was fought on 16 April 1799 between French forces under Napoleon Bonaparte and Jean-Baptiste Kleber and an Ottoman army led by Abdullah Pasha of Damascus, during the siege of Acre. Kleber's 2,000 men held the Ottomans until Bonaparte arrived with 2,000 more and attacked their rear, breaking the Ottoman army.

significance.zh: 此役解除了奥斯曼军队对阿克围城法军的威胁，巩固了法军在叙利亚方向的短暂优势。
significance.en: It removed the Ottoman relief threat to the French besiegers at Acre and secured Bonaparte's brief hold in Syria.

summary.en: The battle of Tel el-Kebir was fought on 13 September 1882 at Tell El Kebir in Egypt, 110 km north-east of Cairo, and proved the decisive engagement of the Anglo-Egyptian War. A British army under Lieutenant General Sir Garnet Wolseley approached under cover of darkness and defeated the entrenched Egyptian force commanded by Ahmed Urabi in a sudden assault.

significance.en: It decided the outcome of the Anglo-Egyptian War and broke Urabi's resistance.

summary.en: The battle of Yu Oc was fought on 19 November 1884, a French victory during the Sino-French War. The action was fought to relieve the French garrison of Tuyen Quang, besieged by Tang Jingsong's Yunnan Army and Liu Yongfu's Black Flag Army. The French commander at Yu Oc, Colonel Jacques Duchesne, later distinguished himself in the conquest of Madagascar.

significance.zh: 此役解除了宣光之围，维持了法军在越南北部的前沿存在。
significance.en: It lifted the siege of Tuyen Quang and preserved the French forward position in northern Vietnam.

summary.en: The battle of Mons was the first major engagement of the British Expeditionary Force in the First World War, fought on 23 August 1914 as part of the Battle of the Frontiers. The British tried to hold the Mons-Conde canal; outnumbered, and with their right flank exposed by the French retreat, they were forced to withdraw.

significance.zh: 此役是英国远征军的首战，其阻击与随后的撤退成为一战初期西线机动作战的标志性事件。
significance.en: It was the BEF's baptism of fire and its fighting retreat set the pattern of the opening mobile phase on the Western Front.

significance.en: The delaying action bought the BEF time and saved it from destruction during the Great Retreat of 1914.

summary.zh: 第一次埃纳河战役是1914年9月协约国对撤退中的德军第一集团军（克卢克）与第二集团军（比洛）发起的追击战，属于马恩河战役之后的「向埃纳河推进」（9月6日至10月1日）。英法军队在埃纳河一线受阻，德军就地构筑阵地，西线自此转入堑壕对峙，运动战阶段结束。
summary.en: The First Battle of the Aisne was the Allied follow-up offensive against the retreating German First and Second Armies in September 1914, after the First Battle of the Marne. The advance halted on the Aisne heights, where the Germans dug in, and the Western Front settled into trench warfare, ending the war of movement.

significance.zh: 此役标志着西线由运动战转入堑壕战，双方自此在埃纳河一线长期对峙。
significance.en: It turned the Western Front from mobile operations into the trench deadlock that defined the following years.

summary.zh: 拉普拉塔战役发生于1957年1月17日，地点在古巴马埃斯特腊山脉的沿海村庄拉普拉塔，是古巴革命期间的战斗。此役是格拉玛号登陆后起义军的首次战斗，对起义军而言是一次成功：此前他们在阿莱格里亚德皮奥战役中惨败，绝大多数成员被杀、受伤或被俘。
summary.en: The battle of La Plata was fought on 17 January 1957 at the coastal village of La Plata in Cuba's Sierra Maestra during the Cuban Revolution. It was the rebels' first battle after the Granma landing, a success following their heavy defeat at Alegria de Pio, where most of their force was killed, wounded or captured.

significance.zh: 作为登陆后的首次胜利，它使卡斯特罗的起义军得以在马埃斯特腊山脉立足。
significance.en: As the first victory after the landing, it allowed Castro's rebels to establish themselves in the Sierra Maestra.

summary.zh: 克节朗战役（印度称南卡曲战役）是1962年中印边境战争的第一场战役。解放军以西藏军区前线指挥部为主，并投入陆军第11师部分分队；印度陆军第7步兵旅在此战中遭受毁灭性打击，失去作战能力，其旅长与四名营级主官被俘。解放军随即乘胜追击，占领藏南达旺地区。
summary.en: The battle of Namka Chu, as India calls it, was the first battle of the 1962 Sino-Indian War. Chinese forces built around the Tibet Military District's front headquarters, with parts of the 11th Division, destroyed the Indian 7th Infantry Brigade, which lost its fighting capacity; its brigade commander and four battalion commanders were captured. Chinese forces then took Tawang.

significance.zh: 此役摧毁印军第7步兵旅，为解放军随后占领达旺打开通路。
significance.en: The destruction of the Indian brigade opened the way for the Chinese advance on Tawang.

summary.zh: 北邑战役发生于1963年1月2日，是越南战争期间南越军队及其美国顾问在定祥省北邑村对越南南方民族解放阵线武装的一次进攻。南越方面出动两个保安营和一个步兵团，并有炮兵与M113装甲车支援，却未能歼灭对手，还损失了数架直升机。
summary.en: The battle of Ap Bac was fought on 2 January 1963 in Dinh Tuong Province, South Vietnam, when government forces and their US advisers attacked a Viet Cong force at Ap Tan Thoi. Two Civil Guard battalions and infantry supported by artillery and M113 carriers failed to destroy the guerrillas and lost several helicopters.

significance.zh: 此役暴露南越军队在指挥与协同上的缺陷，成为美国内部关于介入方式争论的转折点。
significance.en: The setback exposed the South Vietnamese army's command failures and became a turning point in the American debate over the war.

summary.zh: 隆新战役发生于1966年8月18日至21日，地点在南越福绥省隆新附近的橡胶园，是越南战争中的一场交战。交战一方为越共与北越军队，另一方为澳大利亚第一特遣部队。澳军在努伊达基地的炮兵支援下抵御优势兵力，最终守住阵地，战斗持续三日。
summary.en: The battle of Long Tan took place from 18 to 21 August 1966 in a rubber plantation near Long Tan, Phuoc Tuy Province, South Vietnam, during the Vietnam War. It was fought between Viet Cong and North Vietnamese units and elements of the 1st Australian Task Force, who held their position with artillery support against a much larger force.

significance.zh: 它使澳大利亚第一特遣部队守住了在福绥省的驻地，成为澳军参与越战的主要战斗之一。
significance.en: It allowed the 1st Australian Task Force to hold its base in Phuoc Tuy and became one of the best-known Australian actions of the war.

summary.zh: 克雷明纳战役是2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰期间顿巴斯攻势的第一场交战，2022年4月发生在卢甘斯克州克雷明纳。俄军自4月18日起沿东线推进，企图合围顿巴斯的乌军并占领顿涅茨克、卢甘斯克两州。克雷明纳的争夺被视为该攻势的开端，此后东线战事长期胶着。
summary.en: The battle of Kreminna was the first engagement of Russia's Donbas offensive during the 2022 invasion of Ukraine, fought at Kreminna in Luhansk Oblast in April 2022. The offensive began on 18 April with the aim of encircling Ukrainian troops and taking the Donetsk and Luhansk oblasts. The fighting at Kreminna is treated as its opening phase.

significance.zh: 它是俄军入侵第二阶段「顿巴斯攻势」的开端，此后东线战事转入长期消耗。
significance.en: It opened the second strategic phase of the invasion, the Donbas offensive, after which the eastern front settled into a war of attrition.

title.zh: 阿夫迪伊夫卡战役 (2022年—2024年)

summary.zh: 阿夫迪伊夫卡战役是俄乌战争中争夺顿涅茨克州阿夫迪伊夫卡城的战役。2022年俄军入侵后该市外围持续交火，2023年10月10日俄军发动攻势。该城是乌军经营多年的要塞，通往顿涅茨克的门户。2024年2月17日乌军为避免被围撤离，俄军取得2023年以来最大的一次领土推进。
summary.en: The battle of Avdiivka was fought between Russian and Ukrainian forces for the city in Donetsk Oblast during the Russo-Ukrainian war. Fighting along its outskirts continued from 2022, and Russia launched a full offensive on 10 October 2023. Ukraine's commander-in-chief ordered a withdrawal on 17 February 2024 to avoid encirclement, giving Russia its largest gain since 2023.

significance.zh: 俄军攻占这座乌军经营多年的要塞城市，是其2023年以来最大的一次领土推进，顿涅茨克方向的前线态势随之改变。
significance.en: The capture of one of Ukraine's most fortified cities gave Russia its largest territorial gain in months and reshaped the front line in Donetsk Oblast.
